blog.title: How to Reach Kedarnath from Delhi: Train, Bus, Bike and Helicopter Options
blog.content:
Introduction

Kedarnath is one of India's most revered pilgrimage destinations, located in the Garhwal Himalayas of Uttarakhand. Every year, devotees travel from Delhi and other cities to seek blessings at the ancient Kedarnath Temple.

If you are wondering how to reach Kedarnath from Delhi, the journey involves travelling by road to the pilgrimage base area and then completing the final mountain section. You can combine trains, buses, taxis, motorcycles or authorised helicopter services according to your budget, fitness and available time.

This guide covers the main transport options and explains how to plan a smoother journey.

Where Is Kedarnath Located?

Kedarnath Temple is situated in the Rudraprayag district of Uttarakhand. Unlike destinations accessible directly by car, Kedarnath requires a final leg from the road-accessible pilgrimage area.

The usual road journey from Delhi towards the base area is approximately 450–500 km, depending on the route and destination point. Travelling through the hills can take considerably longer than the same distance on a highway.

The final trek from Gaurikund is commonly described as approximately 16 km, although official route arrangements and trail conditions should be checked before travelling.

You can find destination information on the official Uttarakhand Tourism website.

1. Delhi to Kedarnath by Train

Taking a train is a useful option for travellers who want to avoid a long drive from Delhi.

How the Journey Works

  1. Take a train from Delhi to Haridwar or Rishikesh, depending on the available service.

  2. Continue by bus, shared taxi or private vehicle towards Rudraprayag, Guptkashi and Sonprayag.

  3. Follow the authorised local transport arrangements to Gaurikund.

  4. Continue to Kedarnath by trekking or another officially available option.

Train schedules, journey times and fares vary by service and travel date. Book your train tickets in advance during the pilgrimage season.

Best for: Travellers who prefer not to drive long distances themselves.

2. Delhi to Kedarnath by Bus

Buses can be a budget-friendly choice, particularly for solo travellers.

You can look for bus services from Delhi to Haridwar or Rishikesh, then arrange onward transport into the mountains. Depending on the season, local buses, shared jeeps and taxis may be available on different sections of the route.

Tips for Bus Travellers

  • Confirm your arrival point before booking onward transport.

  • Allow enough time between connecting services.

  • Consider an overnight stop if the mountain journey would otherwise be rushed.

  • Confirm local service availability during your travel dates.

Best for: Budget-conscious travellers who are comfortable using multiple transport connections.

3. Delhi to Kedarnath by Bike or Car

Travelling by road gives you flexibility to stop at scenic viewpoints, river confluences and mountain towns.

A commonly used route is:

Delhi → Haridwar → Rishikesh → Devprayag → Srinagar → Rudraprayag → Guptkashi → Sonprayag

From Sonprayag, follow local arrangements to Gaurikund. Do not assume that a private vehicle can reach Kedarnath Temple itself.

Is a Two-Wheeler Suitable?

A motorcycle can work well for experienced riders with properly maintained bikes and suitable riding gear. Mountain roads require controlled speeds, good braking technique and careful attention to weather.

If you are travelling by car, plan parking and onward transport in advance. Follow local traffic restrictions and instructions from the authorities.

Best for: Experienced drivers, families travelling by car and riders who want flexibility.

4. Delhi to Kedarnath by Helicopter

Helicopter services can reduce the amount of trekking required, but they are subject to availability, weather, operational restrictions and official booking arrangements.

Travellers generally need to reach an authorised helipad in the region, such as Phata, Sersi or Guptkashi, depending on the service and booking.

How to Book

  • Complete the required pilgrimage registration.

  • Check available helicopter routes and dates.

  • Use the official booking channel rather than unverified agents.

  • Read baggage, reporting-time, cancellation and passenger eligibility rules carefully.

  • Keep a backup plan in case flights are delayed or cancelled.

For official guidance, see the Shri Badarinath Kedarnath Temple Committee website, which identifies the authorised helicopter booking portal. The Government of India's services portal also provides information about helicopter services.

Important: A helicopter ticket does not remove every travel requirement. Registration, reporting times and local transfers may still apply.

Which Travel Option Is Best?

Travel option Best suited for
Train plus road transport Travellers who want a comfortable long-distance connection
Bus plus local transport Budget travellers
Bike Experienced motorcycle riders
Car or taxi Families and groups who prefer flexible travel
Helicopter Travellers seeking to reduce trekking, subject to availability and eligibility

The right choice depends on your budget, fitness, travel dates and tolerance for changing mountain conditions.

Estimated Kedarnath Travel Budget

The following figures are broad planning estimates per person for the return journey and pilgrimage, not live fares.

Expense Estimated range
Train or bus connections from Delhi ₹800–₹3,000
Local road transport ₹1,000–₹3,000
Accommodation ₹1,000–₹4,000
Food and refreshments ₹800–₹2,000
Miscellaneous expenses ₹500–₹1,500

Your total may vary significantly depending on your transport choice, room type, trip length and seasonal demand. Helicopter travel is an additional expense and should be budgeted separately after checking official fares.

Best Time to Visit Kedarnath

The temple operates seasonally, with opening and closing dates announced for each pilgrimage year. The main season generally falls between spring and autumn.

Before booking, check the official temple and Uttarakhand tourism updates for opening dates, registration, weather, road conditions and any restrictions.

Avoid travelling during dangerous weather conditions simply to keep to a fixed itinerary.

Essential Travel Tips

  • Complete your Yatra registration through the official Uttarakhand registration portal.

  • Book accommodation and transport early during busy dates.

  • Carry warm, waterproof clothing and comfortable trekking footwear.

  • Keep identification, booking confirmations and essential medicines accessible.

  • Follow official advice about altitude, physical fitness and weather.

  • Do not rely on unofficial helicopter-ticket sellers.

  • Allow an extra day if possible to accommodate delays.

Final Thoughts

The best way to reach Kedarnath from Delhi depends on your needs. Trains and buses can keep costs manageable, a bike or car offers flexibility, and authorised helicopter services may reduce the trekking burden.

Whichever option you choose, confirm current arrangements before departure and leave enough time for the mountain section. For more practical travel ideas, visit Best Travel Advisory.

Always follow the latest official pilgrimage instructions rather than relying solely on older travel guides.
